title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Yeah
Or has before
If you don’t think I’ll order Jet’s pizza to deliver to Tigers PR as a thank you for their help this summer camp

Good afternoon from Comerica Park, where it is the last day of Summer Camp. It was the best Summer Camp ever. I didn’t have to talk to any people, I saw my friends from the stands and I’m just not ready to go to Cincinnati yet, that’s in Ohio.
Or something about it being the water fight and them not letting me bring my super soaker in but I don’t think that’s good enough
Yeah, your first one is better
K. This needs to end
Almost done. Then hell begins
Great call on Field Day, though
Going with “Maybe Summer Camp was about the friends we made along the way.”
Your tweet this morning was good
With the quote
Not enough people understand it.
Who’s number should I put down for the pizza
Ron or Ben
JFC you’re going to actually do that. Ron I suppose would be best
Lmao
There’s a certain freedom I feel in spending 50 bucks on pizza to troll
Why is my phone blowing up with random numbers at the exact same time that the delivery guy arrived at Comerica Park
Lol
I just got a text. “This is Comerica Park security, your pizza has arrived.”
Incredible
So do you think I should text Comerica Park security
Because right now I”m just ignoring them
I’m very curious to see if they’re even going to eat the pizza
Idk man, this one is on you to figure out. I am on a call.
This is an incredible social experiment.
Your main troll just sent you good ass pizza.
Are you going to eat it? Or are you going to take those two pizzas - one cheese, one pepperoni and Jet’s bread and a coke - and just leave it outside?
You still on that call
Cuz you’re missing out
What happened?
It is escalating quickly over here, Greg
You had to know this would happen
Have you heard anything?
About?
You haven’t
But if you do, I know you’ll tell me
Surprised you haven’t followed up
I’m not playing the game so I’ll let you tell me when you think it’s right.
Ok. I got kinda emotional earlier, like 6 hours ago, when I started texting you but it went like this
Basically like, you’re my dude and you’ll probably never know how much your trust has meant to me, so I feel like I owe you a certain kind of trust
I got re-assigned to the web desk tonight
Because of the fuckin pizza stunt? Or did you know that was happening and that’s why you went through with the pizza stunt?
Because of the pizza stunt
Jesussss.
Don’t say I’m sorry
I’m so happy
I didn’t think anything like this would come of it
Oh I know this probably isn’t a bad thing in your eyes. Now you avoid dealing with that bullshit.
Like, honestly, I felt I got half a load off my back
Let’s talk tomorrow. I don’t wanna blow you up with texts but I think I’m in a pretty good spot
Lol
“I think I’m in a pretty good spot.” I just got fucking re-assigned for ordering pizza for the Tigers
As a troll
Alright, sounds good. Today was crazy with the happy hour and preparing for Friday.
Didn’t even know there was a Happy Hour
That’s because we did a shit job promoting it. And why the hell would you promote a zoom happy hour when no one watches those any more
That was April
May
When you have people playing baseball on a field, nobody gives AF
Exactly. Sponsorship didn’t seem to give a fuck about that.
